title: Catan Lens study answer file
description: The file study/review.html downloads: expert review answers (study A) or an unaided learning test (study B). Anonymous: people appear only as a code. No real answer files exist yet; recruitment and results are outstanding.

positions.description: Version of the positions file answered, for example positions-2026-10-12.

study.description: expert-review for study A; learning-test for a study B test form.

synthetic.description: true only for made-up demonstration files. The analysis refuses to mix synthetic and real files.

note.description: Only on synthetic files: says that the answers are made up.

reviewer.description: The reviewer or participant code the study team gave out, or empty. Never a name or email address.

form.description: The learning test form, or null for the expert review.

answers.description: One entry per answered position, in position order. Positions without a chosen corner are left out.

position.description: Position id from the positions file, for example P07.

choice.description: The corner the person would play, numbered as on the page. Always an open corner.

plannedSecond.description: First settlement tasks in the expert review only: the second settlement the reviewer would aim for, or null.

acceptable.description: Other open corners the reviewer would also accept, in number order. Empty in a learning test.

confidence.description: How sure, from 1 (a guess) to 5 (certain), or null if not given.

reasoning.description: Optional short reason, in the person's words. Empty in a learning test.
